translations.web: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
translations.bsb: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
translations.kjv: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
translations.asv: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
